# Library notice for borrowers who already reserved a tool

The library needs a notice for borrowers with an existing tool reservation for pickup at the West Room between 12 and 16 May. During those five days, existing West Room reservations will be collected at the North Desk in the same building. The pickup window printed on each confirmation still applies. Bring the confirmation and a library card. Borrowers with a later pickup date should use the location on their confirmation. The change applies to pickups only. Returns remain at the usual return counter.

A few staff suggested keeping the North Desk for the summer. Management has made no decision about summer. In a desk drill, staff located nine of ten test records on the first lookup. These were test records and no borrowers took part. The notice should help people collect their existing reservations during the temporary change.

--- END SOURCE: library-notice.md ---

idea.title: Clear borrower notice for the temporary West Room pickup relocation (12–16 May)
idea.description: Produce a concise, actionable public notice telling borrowers with existing West Room reservations that pickups between 12 and 16 May will be collected at the North Desk, that the printed pickup window on confirmations still applies, and what borrowers must bring; explicitly state that the change affects pickups only and that returns remain at the usual counter.
idea.audience: Library patrons with West Room reservations; general public.
idea.rationale: The source explicitly states the library "needs a notice" for this temporary relocation and lists the exact facts borrowers must know (dates, alternate pickup location, confirmation and library card requirement, exceptions for later pickup dates, and that returns are unchanged). A single clear notice is the most direct editorial opportunity and has high immediate reader value because it solves the concrete communication need the source identifies. Missing/uncertain elements to be resolved during drafting include preferred distribution channels, language for accessibility, and any additional signage or directions inside the building.

Borrowers with a later pickup date should use the location on their confirmation. The change applies to pickups only. Returns remain at the usual return counter."
